_comment: Which vault folders Hermes may write with the vault_write tool. 'free' = writes without asking. 'never' = refused, and hidden from the writer job. Every other folder (and files at the vault root) = 'ask': Hermes asks Nathan first and writes only if his next message is a plain yes. Entries are folder or file paths relative to the vault. Changes apply on the next write (no restart). Names starting with '.' are always 'never'.
